How to read this

Each standing is computed from the knowledge store and the contract only, with the rules show uses. No scope could be bound (no base URL is configured; the built-in fallback address is not a scope), so every operation is scope unresolved; show reports the same. A counted response is a client observation in this scope that is complete, has a status, is within the 180-day staleness horizon and whose evidence file still matches its recorded digest; evidence is hashed, never read for content. "using parameters the contract does not declare" names the query parameter names recorded in the request shape of the newest counted request that the contract does not declare for that operation; an operation with a declared parameter that cannot be resolved to a name and location is not checked. "learned" is the legacy learn verification of the contract shape, shown beside and never merged. Notes are active authored notes with their recorded author, date and evidence run ids; they are claims, not verification. Key sources are recorded links from a path or query key to the earlier response field it came from. No request or response values appear on this page; a stored or declared value the secret scan flags reads withheld.

observed
The newest response retained in this scope completed with a 2xx status, every assertion on it passed, and its evidence still matches; no earlier response retained in this scope failed. This is the label show prints; show also prints observed for an operation observed after a failed attempt.
observed after a failed attempt
Observed, and an earlier response retained in this scope was non-2xx or failed an assertion. When that earlier response cannot be counted, the reason is named.
latest response
The newest response retained in this scope did not pass (a non-2xx status or a failed assertion) or cannot be counted (older than the staleness horizon, evidence missing or changed, incomplete); nothing passed after it. The reason is named beside the status; a response that did not fail but cannot be counted has a neutral marker.
no response recorded
A read with no response retained in this scope.
write — no response recorded
A write (not GET or HEAD) with no response retained in this scope. It may or may not have been sent; nothing in this scope records it.
scope unresolved
No provider, environment and contract identity could be bound for this operation, so no response can be counted for it. The reason is named beside it.
observations unavailable
The retained history could not be read completely, or the operation cannot be held as an identity in the store, or its path was withheld; the reason or code is named, so no label is given.
